articles.title: First Doomsday Warnings, Then Poland Crisis, Iran's "No Limits" Threat, & Now "Mass Casualty" Risk In Moscow
articles.description: First Doomsday Warnings, Then Poland Crisis, Iran's "No Limits" Threat, & Now "Mass Casualty" Risk In Moscow Emergency preparedness warnings across the US, Europe, and Japan have been amplified in corporate media and turned into hysteria for the general public. One big question we have is whether these advisories are coming from an intelligence briefing or deep state globalists doing what they're best at: manipulating the public through headlines. It's hard to say what's fueling the panic, but mentions of "stockpile food" in corporate media headlines jumped on October 23 to their highest level since the Covid-19 panic era of 2021. By Tuesday, the "stockpile food" trend on X had soared but has since faded. What's indisputable is what has happened since those warnings were blasted around corporate media: a political crisis began unfolding in Poland on Friday evening, Iran warned that any renewed conflict with the US would have "no geographical limitation" in retaliation, and by late Saturday morning, the US Embassy in Moscow had warned of a "credible threat of a mass casualty event" in the Russian capital. All of those developments come just a week after an attempted communist revolution in France that led to days of riots, looting, chaos, and embarrassment for the Macron government. It remains to be seen whether the preparedness warnings across the West and among US allies are just fearmongering or whether the threats are credible and were part of some intelligence bulletin sent to allied countries. Notably, this is all happening just days before the US midterm elections next week. Tyler Durden Sat, 10/31/2026 - 21:00
